# Writer's Board

> A whiteboard for planning and writing that a person and an AI agent can share. Boards live in the person's browser. Agents can read the board as JSON, add cards and notes, check quotes against sources, and carry a board between sessions with board_export and board_import.

The writer's own words stay theirs: agents are refused when they try to write the writer's prose, and every agent change is labeled and can be undone.

- [Notes for AI agents: what this is, how to use it, rules and FAQ](/agents.md)
- [Plain page for browsers without WebGL](/?view=agent)
